Callout.Name: Motorcycle Racing
Callout.Advisory: Three bikes, no plates, weaving between traffic.

Script.Line: Three of them and they are doing well over a hundred.
They are going through the traffic like it is stood still.
They have just gone past a junction and they did not slow down for it.

Lines.Approach: Three of them between the lanes and none of them with plates. Do not try to match them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
